reason: The determinism allowlist (§6.5 (3)) forbids the exponent operator, which the language leaves implementation-approximated; _collectContained (reached from search) computed `this.nodeSize ** level`. In both builds it is now the node size to the power level by exact repeated multiplication (scale = 1, then level times scale *= nodeSize), the rest of the line unchanged: every level search reaches lies below the root's, where nodeSize^level < numItems, so each partial product is an integer below 2^53 and exact, and the same integer as before. Closes C-0126 (5).
